sections.html:
Riverton is a Salt Lake County suburb tucked into the valley's southwest corner, roughly 20 miles from downtown Salt Lake City. It covers 12.58 square miles at 4,439 feet. South Jordan lies to the north, Draper to the east, Bluffdale to the south and Herriman to the west. Tax bills, appeals and deed recording are all handled by county offices downtown.

Owners occupy 84.9% of homes, so most sellers are parting with a family house on a block of other owners. Population reached 45,285 in 2020, a 16.9% gain over 2010's 38,753, and is estimated at 47,395 for July 1, 2025.

Riverton housing measureFigure
Median value of owner-occupied homes$592,700
Median gross rent$2,137
Households13,727
Persons per household3.30
Median household income$126,910

Half of households (50.5%) had children under 18 in 2020, and the median age was 31.9.

Riverton began as a farming community in the mid-1850s and was first called Gardnerville. Alfalfa, wheat, sugar beets, tomatoes, poultry, sheep and dairy kept the town busy into the twentieth century. The city incorporated in the late 1940s, a 1996 annexation nearly doubled its size, and Herriman's incorporation in 2000 fixed the western boundary.

Growth came in pieces, which means a house's age depends on where in town it stands.

Several named areas began as specific developments.

  • Tithing Yard Hill is a residential planned development named for a former LDS tithing storage site.
  • Foothills was annexed in the 1980s, de-annexed after the developer's bankruptcy, and re-annexed in 1996.
  • Riverton City Park occupies the site of the former City Hall.

Intermountain Riverton Hospital, which opened in November 2009 with a 24-hour emergency department, sits inside the city limits.

The main roads are Bangerter Highway, the Mountain View Corridor and Redwood Road, and drivers reach Interstate 15 through 12300 South or Bangerter Highway. Bangerter Highway (SR-154) curves north into Riverton and crosses 13400 South, 12600 South and 11400 South. The 12600 South interchange opened on May 19, 2022.

Transit is limited. UTA Route 126, which began in April 2025, runs hourly along 12600 South. Riverton workers average 24.8 minutes to get to work, so mention commute routes in a listing. Say how a house connects to Bangerter Highway, the 12600 South interchange, Redwood Road or the Mountain View Corridor, since buyers weigh that against the drive to I-15.

Jordan School District covers Riverton along with Bluffdale, Copperton, Herriman, South Jordan and most of West Jordan.

  • Elementary: Foothills, Midas Creek, Riverton, Rosamond, Rose Creek and Southland
  • Middle: Oquirrh Hills and South Hills
  • High: Riverton High School

Attendance boundaries ignore city limits, and plenty of Riverton children attend school in a neighboring city. Verify an address with the district before naming a school to a buyer.

The city handles accessory dwellings through an application and an owner-occupancy affidavit filed at City Hall. Short-term rentals go through a conditional use permit and an occupancy declaration. Confirm the city's current ordinance before you describe an apartment in a Riverton house as legal.

A Utah city can require a business license for short-term rentals, though it cannot act against an owner merely for posting a listing online. An undocumented basement apartment may prompt a traditional lender to ask for proof of approval. A cash buyer does not need it.

sections.h2: How to appeal your Riverton valuation
sections.html:
Riverton parcels are assessed by Salt Lake County, which mails a Notice of Valuation and Tax Change in late July. Appeals go to the Board of Equalization between August 1 and September 15, or within 45 days of the notice if that runs later.

  • Submit online, mail form BE01, or go to 2001 South State Street, Suite N3-300, Salt Lake City.
  • Back the appeal with evidence: at least three comparable sales within the year before January 1, a signed settlement statement or a fee appraisal.
  • Only total market value can be contested, not land or improvements alone.
  • The Board adjusts the valuation, never the tax itself.

A hearing officer weighs the evidence, with county review of appeals around October 1 unless the State Tax Commission extends it. If you lose, you have 30 days to take it to the Utah State Tax Commission. Call the appeals office at 385-468-7200 with questions.
Payment is due November 30 even when an appeal is still pending, so pay first and let any adjustment follow. Whatever is still owed at closing comes out of your proceeds through the title company.

Running about 240 miles, the Wasatch Fault has a Salt Lake City segment that last broke some 1,200 to 1,300 years ago. On any one central segment, quakes of magnitude 7 or larger come every 900 to 1,300 years. On March 18, 2020, a magnitude 5.7 quake just north of Magna did moderate damage.

Annual precipitation is 15.76 inches, with winter snow and summers that sometimes pass 100 degrees. Inspectors may check foundations and chimneys, and an as-is seller is not obliged to fix what they find.

sections.h2: Preparing a family home for sale
sections.html:
Most Riverton sellers have lived in the house for years and know its quirks, so put them on paper. Note how old the roof, furnace and water heater are, any basement finishing done without a permit, and repairs you keep postponing. Then pull out the deed, the newest tax notice and your valuation notice if you kept it.

Perfect records are not required. We work from the house as it stands, and clear notes let us give a realistic offer early. If the house has a finished basement, say whether it was permitted. If it has a separate entrance or a kitchen down there, mention that too, since the city's rules on accessory dwellings and owner occupancy will apply to anyone who plans to rent it out. Telling us now means no surprises for either side later.

Once you agree to a price, the closing company verifies ownership and searches for liens or unpaid tax. You sign, the deed is filed with the county recorder, and payment follows. Nobody has to approve a mortgage or order an appraisal, the two steps that most often hold up an ordinary sale. Need a certain closing date? Say so at the outset and we will plan around it.

sections.h2: Selling a Riverton house for cash
sections.html:
Common situations include an inherited family home, a house with a basement apartment that lacks paperwork, or a move on a short deadline.

  1. Describe the property for us.
  2. We look it over and quote a price that fits its condition.
  3. Accept, and the closing is arranged through a title or escrow company.
  4. Recording and payment follow.

No repairs or staging, because we buy as-is. Recording happens at the Salt Lake County recorder, and your closing agent can confirm the details.

faqs.q: What county is Riverton, Utah in?
faqs.a: Salt Lake County. Its offices in the city handle your tax bill and any appeal.

faqs.q: When is the deadline to appeal Riverton property taxes?
faqs.a: Between August 1 and September 15, or 45 days from the notice if that is later.

faqs.q: When are Riverton property taxes due?
faqs.a: November 30, even if an appeal is pending.

faqs.q: Can I sell a Riverton house with an unpermitted basement apartment?
faqs.a: Yes, since we buy as-is. Traditional buyers may demand proof the unit was approved, which a cash sale sidesteps.
Jordan School District, though attendance boundaries ignore city limits and many students go to schools in a neighboring city.
